Subject: Invoice delivery preferences and VAT evidence for Brightlane

Hi Hannah,

Quick question from our AP team as we get set up: how will Redwood issue invoices to Brightlane? We have two consumption buckets that need different handling — regular monthly invoices to our central AP inbox, and occasional VAT evidence for tax compliance.

Options we can support on our side:
- Receive PDF invoices to ap@brightlane.fr (simple, email delivery)
- Portal ingestion (SFTP/API) — preferred for automated matching

Specific asks:
1) Can you confirm whether you can provide the invoice as an e-invoice XML (Peppol-style or simple invoice XML) in addition to the PDF?
2) For VAT evidence (certificates, reverse-charge docs), can those be pushed to the portal or should we expect them via email?
3) Who should be the billing contact at Redwood we should include on the PO and remit-to?

We have a PO ready (PO: 77892) once the delivery path is confirmed. Happy to do a short call this week if that helps.

Best,
Marie DuPont

Hi Marie — thanks for the clear note and the PO number headstart.

Short answers up front:
- We can deliver both PDF and an invoice XML payload. We usually provide a lightweight invoice XML and a PDF copy for invoice matching.
- VAT evidence (e.g., certificates or signed reverse-charge confirmations) can be attached to the invoice record in our portal; we can also send a copy to an email address if you prefer manual workflows.

A couple of details we need from you to finalize the flow:
1) Confirm preferred delivery: EMAIL (single address with PDF copies) OR PORTAL (SFTP or portal API ingest). If PORTAL, let us know if you want SFTP or HTTPS API.
2) Provide the AP mailbox that should receive PDF copies (if EMAIL).
3) VAT registration number you want on the invoice and whether Brightlane will need separate VAT evidence files attached to each invoice or only on request.
4) Remit-to / bank instructions we should use (we can also send a test invoice to confirm mapping).

I attached a sample invoice XML and our AP onboarding checklist to show the XML fields we populate and the onboarding steps (see attachments). If portal is the preference, Kimberly can coordinate the SFTP credentials and an onboarding cadence.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call with your AP lead tomorrow afternoon; Connor is copied to help with any technical mapping.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt

Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Invoice delivery preferences and VAT evidence for Brightlane

Hi Marie — copying a recommendation based on similar EU customers.

If Brightlane expects automated matching against a monthly PO-driven flow, we recommend portal ingestion (SFTP) as the default. Benefits:
- Structured invoice XML + PDF bundle reduces AP exceptions
- We can include VAT metadata fields (vat_number, reverse_charge flag, tax_breakdown) in the XML so your ERP can auto-validate
- Portal lets us attach supporting VAT evidence per invoice (scanned certificates, signed docs) so they are discoverable in one place

Proposed timeline (if SFTP chosen):
1) Day 0: Exchange SFTP host/key + sample mapping (we provide a test XML and PDF)
2) Day 1–3: Brightlane ingest test files; confirm mapping with your ERP team
3) Day 4: Production cutover — first live invoice (we will mark as TEST in the filename during onboarding)

If you must use EMAIL copies, we can send e-invoice XML zipped with the PDF to ap@brightlane.fr and include a simple CSV summary for your matching. That keeps the same data fields but requires manual or semi-automated handling on your side.

For next steps I need: billing contact name + phone + ap@ inbox and the VAT number you want printed on the invoice. Also confirm whether you require an electronic signature field in the XML.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Billing & Collections Lead
Redwood Inference
